test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the aim of Digital Government Mission launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology in January 2022?

options.text: To help workers to meet their financial needs
To have services proactively anticipate citizens’ needs before they approach the services.
To provide welfare service meant for girl child and women
To provide employment information to youth living in rural areas

solution:
The correct answer is __**to have services proactively anticipate citizens’ needs before they approach the services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The aim of the **Digital Government Mission** launched by the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology **in January 2022 is to have services proactively anticipate citizens' needs before they approach the services.
 
• This initiative is part of the broader effort to **enhance the efficiency and responsiveness of government services** through digital means.
 
• The mission seeks to leverage technology to provide seamless and efficient service delivery to citizens.
 
• Proactive service delivery can significantly reduce the time and effort required by citizens to access government services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Digital Government Mission** is a step towards transforming the governance model in India to be more citizen-centric and technology-driven.
 
• It aligns with the vision of a **Digital India**, aiming to ensure that government services are made available to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and increasing internet connectivity.
 
• This mission is expected to enhance transparency, efficiency, and ease of access to public services.
 
• Other initiatives under the Digital India program include digital literacy campaigns, e-governance initiatives, and the development of digital infrastructure.
